title: Associate CAC to Account
content:
Use this guidance when MCeLE prompts you to associate an unlinked CAC with an account. This article covers an existing-account association and the entry point for a new account; detailed account-creation instructions require separate approved guidance.

### Before you begin

1. Insert your CAC into the reader.
2. Navigate to MCeLE.
3. Accept the warning banner.
4. Select the **DoD ID** certificate.
5. Enter your CAC PIN.

### Associate the CAC with an existing account

1. Select **Existing Account Start Here**.
2. Enter your existing MCeLE username and password.
3. Select **Sign In**.
4. Confirm that the CAC is associated with the existing account.

Skip any prerequisite steps you have already completed.

### Associate the CAC when you do not already have an account

1. Complete the CAC sign-in steps above.
2. Select **New Account Start Here**.
3. Follow the account-creation instructions shown there.

This article does not provide detailed new-account creation steps.

### Forgot your MCeLE credentials during association

1. Pause the CAC-association flow.
2. Use the approved MCeLE credential-recovery guidance for the forgotten username or password.
3. Return to **Existing Account Start Here** and continue the CAC-association steps after recovering access.

### CAC is not recognized

1. Try another supported browser.
2. Try a different CAC reader.
3. Retry the association steps.

provenance.description: Adapted from the approved Confluence CAC-association article, preserving the existing-account procedure, the New Account Start Here entry point, credential-recovery return path, and browser or reader troubleshooting without adding unreviewed account-creation details.

user_corrections.description: All five seeded roles may receive CAC-association guidance. Existing-account and new-account entry paths are approved; detailed new-account creation remains a separate source-review dependency.
